name: Survey Design
description: Design questionnaires, sampling frames, and field methodology for large-scale official surveys, ensuring the data collected can support the survey's stated objectives.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Sampling Methodology
description: Apply probability and non-probability sampling techniques, sample size determination, and estimation procedures used in national sample surveys.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: National Accounts Statistics
description: Work with the subject area of national accounts statistics, including compilation and interpretation of relevant national-accounting aggregates. SkillIntel uses this as an operational definition for role and learning mappings.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement; MoSPI Compendium of Roles and Responsibilities of Divisions/Units of MoSPI

name: Price Statistics
description: Work with the subject area of price statistics, including construction, maintenance, interpretation and validation of relevant price-index data. SkillIntel uses this as an operational definition for role and learning mappings.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement; MoSPI Compendium of Roles and Responsibilities of Divisions/Units of MoSPI

name: Labour Statistics
description: Collect, process and interpret employment, unemployment and workforce-participation statistics from labour-force surveys.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Agricultural Statistics
description: Work with the subject area of agricultural statistics and related field data collection and analysis. SkillIntel uses this as an operational definition for role and learning mappings.
source: SIH problem statement; NSSTA training references
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement; NSSTA training activity references

name: Industrial Statistics
description: Work with the subject area of industrial statistics and related production and enterprise data. SkillIntel uses this as an operational definition for role and learning mappings.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: SDG Indicator Monitoring
description: Compile, monitor and report indicators used to track India's progress against the Sustainable Development Goals.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Statistical Metadata Standards
description: Apply statistical metadata and documentation practices so that official datasets remain interpretable and interoperable across the statistical system.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Data Quality Frameworks (Official Statistics)
description: Apply data-quality dimensions relevant to official statistics to assess and improve survey and administrative data.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Data and Statistical Analytics
description: Identify appropriate datasets and apply statistical techniques to analyse and interpret large, complex data in order to uncover trends, patterns and process-improvement opportunities.

name: Data Analytics
description: Apply data-extraction and analytic methods to analyse and evaluate information and provide evidence-based insight.

name: Data Visualisation
description: Use visualisation techniques and interactive graphics to present data patterns, trends and analytical insight to an intended audience.

name: Data Storytelling and Visualisation
description: Combine data insight with visual displays and narrative to communicate patterns, trends and analytical messages in a strategic way.

name: Data Mining and Modelling
description: Establish and deploy data-modelling techniques to support predictive analytics and identify trends and patterns for simulation and forecasting.

name: Data Management
description: Prepare, structure and manage organisational data to support analysis of operational and administrative issues. SkillIntel applies the source competency to statistical data management where appropriate.

name: Data Ethics
description: Apply legal and ethical principles to the collection, use, storage and disposal of data.

name: Data Sharing
description: Assess data assets and support sound decisions about data sharing and organisational use of data.

name: Data Governance – IT
description: Develop, implement and apply guidelines, laws and regulations for handling data across its lifecycle, including advice on proper handling and resolution of data breaches.

name: Geoinformatics (GIS)
description: Create, organise, manage and analyse geospatial data. SkillIntel maps the source competency to the problem statement's GIS requirement.
source_document: FRAC Dictionary — Competencies listing; SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement

name: Artificial Intelligence Application
description: Understand and apply artificial intelligence to technological artefacts while assessing its benefits and challenges.

name: Emerging Technology
description: Maintain knowledge of developments and new applications of emerging technologies, and their benefits, challenges and application to government processes.

name: Python Programming
description: Use Python for statistical data processing, analysis and automation.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: R Programming
description: Use R for statistical computing, modelling and graphics.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: SQL and Database Querying
description: Write SQL queries to retrieve, join and aggregate data held in relational databases.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Stata
description: Use Stata for statistical data cleaning, tabulation and analysis.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Cloud Computing for Data Systems
description: Use cloud infrastructure and services for storage, processing and deployment of statistical data systems.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Cybersecurity
description: Understand, develop and apply cybersecurity policies and procedures to protect against risks and vulnerabilities and to respond to security breaches.

name: Cyber Security Practices
description: Understand core cyber-security practices and threats, and promote safe and secure use of cyber resources.

name: Information Security
description: Use tools and techniques to protect information against unauthorised inspection, modification, recording, disruption or destruction.

name: Data Privacy
description: Apply data-protection principles when handling respondent and administrative data.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Digital Signatures and Authentication
description: Use digital-signature and authentication mechanisms in government document workflows.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Government Cloud Infrastructure
description: Understand government cloud infrastructure, policies and deployment considerations relevant to government data systems.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Digital Public Infrastructure
description: Understand Digital Public Infrastructure concepts and their relevance to government data systems.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: Digital Technology Adoption and Innovation
description: Develop digital technology enhancement projects that support organisational objectives.

name: Leading Others
description: Ability to engage, energise and enable a team to excel.

name: Communication
description: Exchange information and ideas clearly and concisely, in a form appropriate to the audience, in order to explain, persuade and influence.

name: Project Management
description: Plan and manage project resources, timelines, stakeholder engagement and problem resolution to deliver intended outcomes.

name: Professional and Business Ethics
description: Foster strong ethical standards and resolve ethical conflicts in accordance with relevant principles and processes.

name: Integrity
description: Consistently behave in an open, fair and transparent manner; honour commitments; and uphold public service values.

name: Decision Making
description: Make timely, well-informed decisions that take account of relevant facts, data, risks and differing points of view.

name: Change Management
description: Show flexibility and adaptability to change, and support the successful implementation of new initiatives. SkillIntel uses this Behavioural entry as the primary reference where the source contains multiple Change Management entries.

name: Problem Solving
description: Understand a situation by breaking it into smaller parts, organising information systematically, and setting priorities.

name: Planning and Organizing
description: Plan, organise and monitor work with effective use of resources such as time, money and people.

name: Stakeholder Management
description: Build, engage and sustain relationships with stakeholders, aligning expectations with organisational requirements to support successful outcomes.

name: SPSS
description: Use SPSS for statistical data cleaning, tabulation and analysis.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID

name: SAS
description: Use SAS for statistical data processing, analysis and reporting.
source_document: SIH 2025/26 Problem Statement — Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, DIID
